paper_metadata.title: Creep behavior of powder metallurgy Ni-based superalloys with minor scandium

evidence.quote: The creep behavior of two PM superalloys, U720Li and RR1000, each alloyed with trace amount of Sc, was systematically investigated.
系统研究了两种含微量元素钪的粉末高温合金U720Li 和 RR1000 的蠕变行为。

The compositions of two typical powder metallurgy (PM) superalloys, U720Li and RR1000, two typical and broadly applied PM superalloys for turbine engines, enhanced with minor Sc additions of 0.043 wt.% Sc and 0.064 wt.% Sc and designated as U-0.043 and R-0.064, respectively, are presented in Table 1.

The production commenced with the creation of master alloys via VIM.
Subsequently, powders with a particle size below 150 μm were produced through argon atomization and sieving.
These powders were then consolidated through hot extrusion at 1130 °C, employing an area reduction ratio of 16:1.
U-0.043 billets underwent heat treatment at 1095 °C for 4 h, followed by oil quenching, and then aged at 760 °C for 16 h with air cooling.
